items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Ripple wins final US approval for national trust bank
items.summary: The approval clears the way for Ripple to manage reserves backing its RLUSD stablecoin and provide digital asset custody.

items.title: Aviva Investors launches tokenized share class of $29B Sterling fund on XRP Ledger
items.summary: The move marks Aviva’s second fund to list tokenized shares, part of a broader collaboration to bring more tokenized funds to the XRP Ledger.
